title: Narcooo/inkos
claim: Agent system for long-form story creation — novels, screenplays, interactive film/games, IP franchises and multilingual translation — shipped as an npm package (@actalk/inkos) under AGPL.
why_good: Long-form consistency (plot state, character continuity) is exactly what chat-based AI writing can't hold, and inkos productizes the full pipeline for it. 1,558 forks with near-daily commits shows real builder adoption, rooted in the Chinese web-novel/IP market that already pays for writing throughput.
value: A web-novel writer paid by the chapter — the readable-output-per-hour number is literally their wage. Monthly subscription priced against one extra chapter a day.
risk: The demand is real but the quality ceiling belongs to the model, not to you; if frontier models close the long-form consistency gap natively, the orchestration layer evaporates.

zh.claim: 面向长篇创作的智能体系统 — 长短篇小说、剧本、互动影游、IP 内容与多语言翻译，以 npm 包（@actalk/inkos）发布，AGPL 协议。
zh.why_good: 长篇一致性（情节状态、人物连续性）正是聊天式 AI 写作守不住的东西，inkos 把整条流水线产品化。1,558 个 fork 加上近乎日更的提交说明有真实的开发者采用，且扎根于本就为写作产能付费的中文网文/IP 市场。
zh.value: 按章拿钱的网文作者——每小时能出多少可读文字，字面上就是他的工资。月订阅，对标「一天多写一章」。
zh.risk: 需求是真的，但质量天花板归模型不归你；前沿模型一旦原生解决长篇一致性，中间这层编排就蒸发了。
zh.hook: 想写完一本网文的人，不是想跑一个 npm 包的人：8685 星、1631 fork 说明胃口是真的，issue 区说明写手卡在第四章。
zh.does: 一条把长篇故事撑住的 agent 流水线——情节状态、人物连续性、世界规则——从大纲一路推到一章又一章，同一套骨架还能出剧本、互动游戏和翻译。以 npm 包（@actalk/inkos）交付，得自己配模型 key。
zh.gap: 只有极客用得了，而且出来的东西还是流水账。真正想要它的人是写网文的，不是写 Node 的：要先装 Node 20+、手改 .env、挑模型供应商，才能写下第一句；侥幸装上的那批人报告章节字数失控、开局全都撞在同一个矿洞里。
zh.counter: 「同质化」不是能打补丁的 bug，那就是让模型连写 300 章的必然结果，所有竞品都会撞上同一堵墙。同时番茄、起点这些平台正在给已经住在那里的写手直接发自家写作助手，后面还连着分发和稿费。让烂小说写得更快的工具，没人买。
zh.differentiator: 别交付流水线，交付稿子。一键桌面安装、模型 key 预置，产品承诺只收窄到 issue 区证明已经坏掉的那一件事：把 20 万字撑住不崩、每章字数就是作者要的那个数。卖「不一样」而不是卖「量」——写到第一章就提示你又在写那个下矿开局。冷启动（中文）：inkos 自己的 issue 区，加番茄小说作者交流群与龙的天空论坛，写手自己在那里抱怨这几件事；冷启动（英文）：r/WritingWithAI 与 r/HFY 搜 lost the plot chapter。

voices.quote: 大家没有发现这个问题吗？多开几本同类型的小说，比如：玄幻，你会发现主角开局要么下坑要么下矿要么捡垃圾，接着有个对他怀恨在心的npc张虎或者其他，再来一个对他好的老头吧啦吧啦，说实话去除人名，这些故事几乎一样。发散性严重不足。
AI味道还是有点，感觉写出来就像流水账，小说第一章字数正常，后面的字数无法控制
一开始我用很详细的和它说建立书， 他要啥给啥，然后总是建立失败， 说参数不对，引号问题，但是他又解决不了，就一直卡在这里。

hook: Someone who wants to finish a web novel, not someone who wants to run an npm package: 8.7k stars and 1.6k forks say the appetite is real, and the issue tracker says the writer is stuck at chapter four.
does: An agent pipeline that holds a long story together — plot state, character continuity, four-transformation-style world rules — and drives it from outline to chapter after chapter, with screenplay, interactive-game and translation modes on the same spine. It ships as an npm package (@actalk/inkos) you configure with your own model key.
gap: Only geeks can use it, and the output still reads like filler. The person who wants this is a web-novel writer, not a Node developer: they must install Node 20+, hand-edit a .env, and pick a model provider before the first sentence — and the ones who get through report chapters that lose word-count control and plots that converge on the same opening.
counter: The sameness complaint is not a bug you can patch — it is what a language model does when you ask it for 300 chapters, and every competitor will hit the same wall. Meanwhile Chinese platforms (番茄/起点) are shipping their own authoring assistants to the writers who already live there, with the distribution and the payout attached. A tool that makes bad novels faster has no buyer.
differentiator: Do not ship a pipeline; ship a manuscript. One-click desktop install with a model key pre-wired, and the product's promise is narrowed to the single job the issue tracker proves is broken: keep a 200k-character story consistent and keep each chapter at the length the writer asked for. Sell the divergence, not the volume — a 'sameness check' that flags when chapter one is drifting into the same mine-shaft opening as everyone else's. Cold start (Chinese): the inkos issue tracker itself plus 番茄小说作者交流 and 龙的天空 forums, where writers post exactly these complaints; Cold start (English): r/WritingWithAI and r/HFY, search 'lost the plot chapter'.
consumer_angle: The ordinary person here is a working web-novel author, and the finished thing they walk away with is a chapter they can publish today — this qualifies under the one allowed exception (AI producing a deliverable a human uses), not as developer infrastructure.
